assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina, paired-end), gastrocnemius muscle, ~20-week-old male mice (S4.15.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of skeletal-muscle-specific Sirt6 deletion (Myl1-Cre; Sirt6 flox/flox) vs WT (Sirt6 flox/flox) on the gastrocnemius transcriptome at basal (untrained) condition (S2.4.p1, FIG4a, GEO overall design). This is a genotype estimand, not an exercise estimand.
exercise_factor_in_rnaseq: none: the RNA-seq mice are not described as trained; Figs 2-4 phenotyping is 'at basal condition'; GEO characteristics list only strain, tissue, age, genotype
sample_inclusion: n = 3 per genotype ('Each sample was analyzed in triplicate', FIG4a); GEO: WT1/WT4/WT6, KO3/KO6/KO7
planned_contrasts: Sirt6 KO vs WT, gastrocnemius, basal (FIG4a volcano; S2.4.p1); no paper DEG count stated
exercise_comparisons_in_paper: Exercise contrasts in the paper are (i) human GSE9103 trained vs sedentary microarray (FIG1a, S4.16.p1; a different accession), and (ii) treadmill performance/Western blots in mice (FIG1b, FIG1d-j, FIG5, FIG6) with no transcriptome profiling.
paper_method: FIG4 legend: 'Negative binomial Wald Test using DESeq2 (a)'; S4.15.p1 instead describes StringTie read counts, FPKM filter, log2(FPKM+1), quantile normalization and fold-change significance.
paper_results: Top-20 down in KO include CREB targets Ppargc1a, Nr4a3, Nr4a1; Creb1 down (FIG4b, S2.4.p1). No total DEG count stated.
